items.text_th: แนวทางการอัพพื้นที่สวนจะใช้เงินสวน 128M ค่ะ ปลดพื้นที่ด้านข้างก่อน 2 ข้าง ช่องละ 10M และปลดพื้นที่ย่อย 12 ช่อง ค่าปลดจะคิดตามสเต็ป 2M > 3M > 4M > 5M > 6M > 7M > 8M > 10M > 12M > 14M > 17M > 20M รวมทั้งหมด 128M จะได้พื้นที่ปลูกเพิ่มรวมของเดิม 600 ต้นค่ะ

items.text_en: Garden expansion guide: it costs 128M garden money total. Open the 2 side areas first, 10M per plot, then open the 12 small plots, with prices going up in steps: 2M > 3M > 4M > 5M > 6M > 7M > 8M > 10M > 12M > 14M > 17M > 20M, 128M total. Counting your old land, you can plant 600 crops.
items.summary_en: Guide: expanding the garden costs 128M for 600 planting plots.

items.summary_vn: Người mới khen game hiện đại, vui khi chơi cùng bạn, thích photo booth.
items.text_en: Honestly really good, very modern. I just started playing. If you invite lots of friends it's super fun and you can play long-term. My favorite is the photo booth.
items.summary_en: New player praises the modern feel, fun with friends, and the photo booth.

items.text_th: ดีมากกหสุกมากๆเลยค่าา🥹🫰🏻
items.text_vn: Hay lắm, vui cực luôn ạ 🥹🫰🏻
items.summary_vn: Khen game hay và rất vui.
items.text_en: So good, super fun 🥹🫰🏻
items.summary_en: Says the game is good and very fun.

items.text_th: เล่นสนุกก
items.text_vn: Chơi vuiii.
items.summary_vn: Khen game chơi vui.
items.text_en: Fun to playyy.
items.summary_en: Says the game is fun to play.

items.text_th: สนุกมากกกกกกกกกกกกกก
items.text_vn: Vui lắmmmmmmmmmmmmm.
items.summary_vn: Khen game cực kỳ vui.
items.text_en: So much funnnnnnnnnnnnn.
items.summary_en: Says the game is extremely fun.

items.text_th: เอาอันเก่ากลับมา. บชเก่าหายพอจะเชื่อมเข้าก็เข้าไม่ได้เล่นมาตั้งหลายปีพอมาเจองี้เสียความรุ้สึกมาก😊
items.text_vn: Trả bản cũ lại đi. Tài khoản cũ mất rồi, liên kết vào cũng không được. Chơi bao nhiêu năm mà gặp thế này buồn lắm 😊
items.summary_vn: Mất tài khoản cũ, không liên kết được.
items.text_en: Bring back the old version. My old account is gone and I can't link it either. Played for so many years and this happens, so sad 😊
items.summary_en: Lost their old account and can't link it.

items.text_th: หมา. เเล้วจะเข้าไอเก่ายังไงในเมื่อไม่มีตัวเกมเก่าให้โหลด?
items.text_vn: Chó thật. Thế giờ vào tài khoản cũ kiểu gì khi không còn bản game cũ để tải?
items.summary_vn: Không còn bản game cũ để tải về vào tài khoản cũ.
items.text_en: Damn it. So how am I supposed to get into my old account when the old version isn't available to download anymore?
items.summary_en: Old version is no longer downloadable to access the old account.

report.overview: Có 62 feedback trong ngày từ Facebook Group. Post, comment, bài khoe, rao bán và thảo luận Facebook đều được giữ lại khi truy cập được.

quote.text_th: มีใครที่พึ่งเข้ามาเล่นใหม่ หรือ กำลังหาเพื่อนเล่นด้วยไหมคะ เราอยากมีเพื่อนเล่นด้วยกันงับเราเป็นมิตร คุยเก่ง เล่นไม่ดึกมาก ไม่เกิน 5 ทุ่มงับขอเพื่อนๆที่อายุ 20+นะคะ เพราะเรา20+แล้วว
quote.text_vn: Có ai mới vào chơi hoặc đang tìm bạn chơi cùng không? Mình muốn có bạn chơi chung, mình thân thiện, nói chuyện nhiều, không chơi khuya lắm, không quá 11 giờ đêm. Xin bạn từ 20 tuổi trở lên nhé vì mình 20+ rồi

quote.text_th: ช่วยหน่อยยยค่าาาเชื่อมโยงบัญชีจากแอพเดิมมาvngไม่ได้เลยค่ะด้านล่างรูปมีคำอธิบายนะคะว่าทำอะไรไปบ้างมันมีวิธีอื่นมั้ยคะ หรือใครที่เพิ่งย้ายแอพแล้วเจอแบบเดียวกัน ทำยังไงให้เข้าได้บ้าง อยากกลับไปเล่นแล้วค่ะ
quote.text_vn: Giúp với ạ, không liên kết được tài khoản từ app cũ sang VNG. Bên dưới ảnh có giải thích mình đã làm gì. Có cách nào khác không, hay ai mới chuyển app gặp tình trạng tương tự thì làm sao để vào được? Muốn quay lại chơi lắm
